name: Ion Lorentz-force mover in analytic uniform fields
purpose: Verify a charged Na+ reaches the production Lorentz callback and converges under refinement.
production_capability: Na+ mass/charge, uniform E/B fields, Moon acceleration callback, second-order mover midpoint-node wiring.
configuration: Dedicated no-SPICE Na,NA_PLUS fixture; initial radius 100 lunar radii; one gyroperiod; 64/128/256/512 steps. The unchanged <=1% gate rejected the preliminary 32/64/128/256 sequence at 1.705% finest error.
independent_reference: Separate high-resolution RK4 integration of the analytic uniform-field q(E+v cross B)/m equation plus lunar point gravity; gravity remains active and is not removed for the test.
units: V m^-1, T, C, kg, m, m s^-1, rad s^-1
procedure: Run four production-mover levels over one qB/m period and compare every endpoint to the independent 32768-step reference.
acceptance_criteria: Errors decrease, all three successive ratios are >=3, and the finest scaled state error is <=1%.
expected_failure_modes: null or incorrect midpoint AMR node
status_semantics: PASS applies only to the dedicated fixture; it does not enable Na+ in the normal baseline.
